user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search answers and navigational links.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads. Not used for model training.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawled content used in training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-initiated actions in ChatGPT, Custom GPTs, and GPT Actions.
user_agents.scope: User-triggered requests visiting web pages; does not crawl automatically.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content potentially contributing to AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Enhances the utility and safety of generative AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves content in response to user queries.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Builds Google search indexes and powers Discover, Search, Images, and News.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google Images, Discover, and Search features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and Search features presenting images, logos, and favicons.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-Image or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content for video-related Google Search features and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-Video or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for the Google News product and app.
user_agents.scope: The Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-News or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for all surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Powers Search testing tools including Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as the Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler used by product teams for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content for internal R&D; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Affects crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content use for training Gemini models and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training future Gemini models powering Gemini Apps and Vertex AI, plus Search grounding.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple products and provides data for foundation models.
user_agents.scope: General web search crawling and rendering for Spotlight, Siri, and Safari.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls whether website content trains Apple's generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Controls usage of crawled data for generative AI training without crawling webpages.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta's apps to gather, cache, and display preview information.
user_agents.scope: Content of an app or website shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content analyzed to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow for the crawler to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled to improve advertising and other business products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow for the crawler to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models or indexing content directly.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training foundation AI models or improving products through direct indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow for the crawler to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users to help AI navigate websites and complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are requested by the user.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Content used to provide accurate customer information and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives and noarchive meta tag.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Content eligible for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt directives specific to Amzn-SearchBot or general search bots.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions such as responding to Alexa queries.
user_agents.scope: Live information fetched from the web on a user's behalf; not for AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide an open copy of the Internet for research.
user_agents.scope: A randomly selected subset and sample of the public web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow CCBot in robots.txt or request addition to the opt-out registry.
